lines.text: The LORD tells Joshua to choose twelve men, one from each tribe, to take stones from the middle of the Jordan.
The twelve men carry the stones to the camp as a memorial, so children will ask what they mean.
Joshua sets up twelve stones at Gilgal, and the priests with the ark cross after everyone else.

wrong_details.wrong: Joshua sets up twelve stones at Gilgal
wrong_details.true: Joshua sets up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan

lines.text: About 40,000 armed troops cross before the LORD, and when the priests step onto dry land, the waters return.
Israel camps at Shittim, and the Jordan's drying, like the Red Sea's, makes the Amorite and Canaanite kings' hearts melt.
